title: Cheesy Ranch Potatoes & Smoked Sausage
ingredients: Salt and black pepper, to taste
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400°F (200°C). Lightly grease a 9x13-inch baking dish.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes and sliced sausage with olive oil, ranch seasoning, garlic powder, onion powder, salt, and pepper.
Spread the mixture evenly in the prepared baking dish and bake for 30 minutes, stirring halfway through.
In a small bowl, combine the sour cream, milk, and melted butter.
Remove the baking dish from the oven and pour the creamy mixture over the potatoes and sausage.
Sprinkle the cheddar and mozzarella cheeses evenly over the top.
Return to the oven and bake for an additional 10 to 15 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with parsley and serve hot. Store leftovers covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
notes: Total Time: 1 hour. Approximately 510 calories per serving. Recipe extracted from Facebook reel caption by Quotidian Recipes.
